svg.title: Nara Personal AI — mobile app concept
svg.desc: Three mobile screens for a personal AI agent: home, chat, and voice, with memory and automation shortcuts.

g.text: Your private assistant, ready when you are
A calmer way to work with AI.
Chat, talk, remember, and automate — from one personal space.
Mau mulai dari chat atau suara?
Nara dapat keliru. Periksa hal penting sebelum bertindak.
Bicara seperti biasa. Kamu bisa mengakhiri sesi kapan saja.
